reviews.body: Great fit, can't wait to wear it! Given the price, I am nervous about potential discoloration mentioned in other reviews as I haven't worn it yet (it's for a vacation coming up), but I will update my review if it happens to me. The fit is so perfect, cuts up the thigh just enough that it doesn't make you look boxy, the perfect amount of booty coverage for me (not full coverage but your butt isn't hanging out either), I typically like sweetheart cut but this works well for a swimsuit to hold you in while still having support to keep you lifted and looking good. And most importantly, a good amount of tummy control and ruching to flatter the tummy and make you feel held in (currently post c-section and it does a great job camouflaging the incision and belly pouch it caused). I am 5'2, about 145 lbs and got a size medium - I'd say true to size - keeping in mind it will be a bit snug to hold you in, if you want it less tight, go up a size.

I am a size 14 with a tummy. I did get the 16w since there is not a long torso option This bathing suit was my go to all summer. I will be purchasing another. The quality is very nice. It has thick material but not so thick that you can't breathe. I still felt supported . Not superr revealing but has a flattering neck line. It's fits well and I felt confident.
